about.title: Engineering Excellence
about.subtitle: About Me
about.content:
Results-driven QA Lead with 7+ years of experience in end-to-end testing across web, mobile, desktop, and API systems.

Currently working as Software Test Specialist and Scrum Master at Amdocs, leading QA delivery for enterprise-scale telecom platforms.

Specialized in AI-powered testing, prompt engineering, API validation, ETL testing, automation acceleration, and Agile delivery methodologies.

Education:
B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering – ITS Engineering College (Greater Noida, India)

projects.title: Featured Work
projects.subtitle: Success Stories
projects.p1_desc: Autonomous QA agent that extracts test scenarios from natural language documentation with 95% accuracy.
projects.p2_desc: Dynamic portfolio application that adapts its content based on the target job description using prompt engineering.
projects.p3_desc: Real-time monitoring dashboard for automated test execution with AI defect analysis and root cause detection.

experience.title: Career Journey
experience.subtitle: Experience
experience.exp1_desc:
• Lead analysis and testing delivery across large-scale platform projects, ensuring high-quality releases and ownership of delivery KPIs.
• Expertly manage multiple functional areas, conducting requirements gathering, defining user stories, and establishing BDD acceptance criteria.
• Reduced regression effort using AI-assisted test case generation and optimization via ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, and Claude.
• Execute complex test strategies and planning encompassing System, SIT, and Regression testing cycles.
• Perform API and ETL validation for data-intensive systems, including data mapping and ETL workflow design for migrations.
• Act as Scrum Master handling sprint planning, workshops, walkthroughs, and stakeholder communication with Solution Consultants, PMs, and clients.
• Drive defect management, triage, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using Jira to ensure continuous process improvement.
• Mentor team of 3 QA engineers, focusing on capability building and adherence to regulatory and compliance awareness.
experience.exp2_desc:
• Tested Adobe Acrobat (Liquid Mode) with AI-based document processing features, validating AI output accuracy and performance.
• Designed comprehensive test scenarios covering edge cases, real-world data inputs, and platform-specific functional areas.
• Improved defect detection through structured analysis and rigorous SIT/Regression testing phases.
• Collaborated with cross-functional developers and PMs to resolve critical defects discovered during exploratory testing.
experience.exp3_desc:
• Tested SaaS automation platform across web and mobile environments using cross-browser testing methodologies.
• Performed root cause analysis and defect tracking to ensure platform stability during rapid release cycles.
